headline: Partner with RoboGrinder
intro: Companies, local businesses, families, and friends help our students design, build, and compete. Support RoboGrinder with funding, equipment, or expertise to keep our robots and our team moving through the season.

benefits.title: Meet the team
benefits.description: Share career opportunities and engineering experience through sponsor sessions included in your tier.

benefits.title: Lab tours & outreach
benefits.description: See our projects in the lab and connect at team events, with opportunities based on your tier.

benefits.title: Sponsor recognition
benefits.description: Get recognition on our robots, website, or team media as included in your sponsorship tier.
